name: EMA Pullback (H1 signal)
author: trading_system
notes: H1-signal variant of ema_pullback, used for the P15 stage 2 optimisation run so that the fold geometry matches the stage 1.5 null calibration (EURUSD H1). Identical to the H4 spec in every other field; only signal_tf/entry_tf differ, which changes what confirmation_window_bars, expire_after_bars and cooldown_bars_after_loss count in.
